highway.recommendation: Route through already-fragmented land where feasible; plan wildlife crossings if biodiversity sensitivity exceeds moderate threshold.

industrial.recommendation: Prioritize sites with existing industrial land-use history to avoid greenfield conversion; assess groundwater table before finalizing.

township.recommendation: Preserve a minimum green-cover ratio in the master plan; evaluate local water table capacity against projected household density.

commercial.recommendation: Favor infill development over peripheral expansion; incorporate permeable surfacing to manage stormwater runoff.

energy.recommendation: Conduct an early habitat survey given elevated biodiversity sensitivity; consider alternative siting if within a designated ecological buffer zone.
